name: busabase
description: The open-source database and workspace for AI agents: drive a Busabase workspace and create complete workspace apps.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Busabase with browser-based OAuth. Read and write records, docs, files, skills and apps in the open-source database and workspace for AI agents. Every write is a change request: it lands at once with write access and waits for a person's review otherwise.
defaultPrompt: Find the most relevant Busabase knowledge about this topic.
Propose a reviewed change to a Busabase record.
Show Busabase change requests awaiting my review.
Create a new Busabase workspace app from this product idea.
